capabilities: Build names from tokens such as date, number and document name
Filter characters with regex-style name patterns
Run rename actions from the context menu
disambiguation: Not a general attachment manager; it only renames and moves existing attachments according to patterns.
extras: Up to four patterns can be configured; the README notes that embeds are updated only when Obsidian's automatic link updates are enabled, and includes developer build instructions.
problem: Attachments arrive with arbitrary names and locations, so filing them consistently beside their notes means renaming and moving each one by hand.

relations.evidence: Install the hot reload plugin to get automatic reload when saving a .ts file

summary: Renames and moves note attachments using configurable filename patterns built from tokens for dates, paths, numbers and the active note.
